description: Person selections and edge inspection regions of #458 step E5. Each target is one whole person of the SM1 quality set (build/tmp/sm1/quality/prompts.json) on the E4 input set (4096 px long edge). start: the point (normalized photo coordinates) that the first stroke goes through; reference: the E1 PyTorch box mask of base plus at the E4 input size (the region that the simulated strokes stay inside, not an edge ground truth). regions: the edge crops of the report, chosen by eye on the photos; center in normalized photo coordinates, size in pixels of the 4096 px input. kind hair: fine strands or curls, a soft edge is expected. kind hard: skin or clothing against a textured or busy background, a sharp edge is expected and every soft or isolated pixel there is an error.
